whyWeBuilt.label: Why We Built It
whyWeBuilt.heading: Recruiters should not lose hours
whyWeBuilt.p1: Recruiters already spend enough time sourcing candidates, speaking with clients, and managing hiring processes. The work between receiving a candidate resume and sending a client-ready submission is often repetitive, manual, and easy to underestimate.
whyWeBuilt.p2: ResumeDOG was built to reduce that bottleneck. It helps recruitment teams prepare cleaner, translated, anonymized, and professionally formatted resumes without rebuilding every document from scratch.
whyWeBuilt.p3: The goal is not to replace recruiter judgment. The goal is to remove the formatting and document preparation work that slows recruiters down before a candidate can be presented properly.
whyWeBuilt.quote: The problem was never the candidates. It was the amount of manual work needed before a strong candidate could be sent to the client.

why.heading: Strong candidates should not be slowed down by
why.p1: Recruiters are judged on speed, accuracy, and the quality of candidate submissions. But before a candidate can be sent to a client, recruiters often need to clean formatting, rewrite unclear sections, translate content, anonymize personal details, and adjust the document to fit agency or client expectations.
why.p2: ResumeDOG exists to make that preparation process faster and more consistent, while still leaving final judgment and review in the hands of recruiters.
